record_scope: normalized saved source-generation completion metadata and queue timestamp collection only; not a completed-model performance result or independent experiment-level numeric audit

roll_validation_holdout.scope: independent new layouts and render seeds; shared actual source-training HDR

source_preparation.failure_policy: retain failed groups and stop; no state/roll resampling or dropped rows

generation_protocol.source_intervention: independent continuous camera-local optical-axis roll; one RGB per inference
generation_protocol.heldout_scope: disjoint new layout IDs and render seeds; shared source-training HDR background
generation_protocol.population_operation: append new physical RGB; retain all18590 source and original1506 validation unchanged
generation_protocol.failure_policy: stop and preserve partial output; no state/seed resampling or relaxed geometry thresholds

source_generation_cost.boundary: Durations from saved queue step started_at/finished_at; subprocess wall includes launch/startup/termination, not isolated render GPU kernel or CPU math. Child serial envelope includes inter-step gaps; supervisor source_data stage also includes controller startup/finalization. Excludes subsequent preflight and all model training/evaluation.
source_generation_cost.arithmetic: integer microseconds from saved ISO queue timestamps; sums converted to seconds only for display

geometry_check_contract.applies_to: new4608 actual physical RGB only; existing source not re-audited
geometry_check_contract.method: existing prepare_group complete geometry_targets and per-group16 Q*M*U cross-state checks
geometry_check_contract.saved_results: new_group_checks copied from prepared.json; no GT recomputation in this collection

limitations: Roll validation has independent layout/group/sample IDs and declared generated seeds, with the same available source-training HDR background. It is not background or domain holdout.
20096 retained original train/validation metadata rows have no recorded seed. Full historical raw-seed provenance is unavailable; this is not a certification of the entire historical seed chain.
Render/prepare costs are saved subprocess queue wall intervals, not isolated GPU render time or CPU math time. Source generation, zero-update preflight and later model training are separate stages.
Only saved scalar/metadata records were read. No source plan, full ID/seed arrays, weights, RGB, H/C/XYZ/U/M, feature matrices or raw run was downloaded.
